description.narrative:
The project is a one day activity. The activity is a conference to which the embassy has agreed to give financial support. This is the fourth time the conference is held.
The confernce aims to gather 200 women from different fields. The speakers of the conference are among others, the Royal Norwegian Ambassador to Malawi and other female CEOs from businesses and NGOs in the country, It seeks to promote female leadership and inspire women.
The outcomes of the conference are:
- Create a platform for women executives to connect, build relationships, and foster a supportive network that encourages collaboration and mentorship. - To enable participants to share their experiences, challenges and successes, and to gain valuable insights and perspectives from fellow women leaders. - Explore strategies and solutions to address persistent gender disparities in executive leadership roles and work towards creating a more equitable and inclusive business environment. - Develop leadership skills though interactive discussions and expert-led sessions. - Explore ways to influence organizational policies, practices and cultures to create supportive environments that enable women to thrive in leadership positions. - To bring together 200 women from different fields like Corporate, Athelics ans Sports, Community Development, Charity, Religion, Health, Academia, Civil Society, Politics, Public Service, Entrepreneurship and Creative Arts among others.
